{{Top|leg}}
'''Spin-sealed''' was a type of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] that naturally occurred in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> More powerful than regular tibanna gas, the natural supply was [[Figg & Associates]]' most closely guarded secret. They had secret agreements to supply a number of arms manufacturers, including [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], [[Nova Designs Incorporated]], [[Opish & Bethal Weapons]], and [[Kethren Systems]].
